[quote=united_hydronia;59959582][b]The Battle[/b]
The 10 minutes timer elapsed. The admiral waited. No sign of Jomslandic movement. He was just about to give the order to fire, when a boom was heard, the Kaiserreich had arrived. They knew it would only be a matter of time.

The radars filled up with numbers of aircraft. The Hydronians tried to target them with anti-air missiles, but soon realised that they were decoys. The two aircraft carriers deployed their arsenal of bombers, then quickly began to retreat away from the coast to ensure they took minimal damage. 5 Xowl-6 stealth bombing planes took to the sky and began to rain hell down upon the technocratic fleet as well as a section of their coastal defences, attempting to create an opening.

In order to keep the bombers and the actual fleet safe from the TK missiles, laser systems were used to disrupt the TK missiles guiding systems, sending them in all directions, mostly missing Hydronian assets.

Once a gap had been made in the coastal defences, the enemy had to be distracted. The Hydronians would make a landing at all costs. Suicide drones were deployed to surround and overwhelm the enemy, trying to block their radars and making use of electronic jamming payloads, but with little success due to the already jammed Hydronian systems. 

The Hydronians must resort to missiles. A barrage of missiles were launched from the destroyers, targeted a a select group of TK ships. Once neutralised, this group provided a small opening for a single amphibious assault vessel to get behind enemy lines and speed towards the coast.

Drones and jets continued to circle around the landing site as the amphibious assault vessel arrived. Troops swarmed out of it and thanks to previous satellite observations, the landing site was relatively unmanned, at least compared to other coastal sites. The troops still came under heavy fire. A foothold was quickly established and soon a second and third wave of troops landed, but the forth never came. The forth amphibious assault vessel was sunk by the Jomslandic forces.

At this point in the battle, the 15th fleet arrived from the south, brining an additional 10 ships to the battle. They also came prepared with a helicopter full of paratroopers. These paratroopers landed in the establishment foothold and helped to further reinforce Hydronian positions. From this point, the troops expanded the foothold until they met resistance.

Back in the water, the remaining destroyers and frigates targeted Technocratic and Jomslandic aircraft carriers. With support from the Bobians and Sikirskian, their goal was to neutralise as many ships as possible, to help distract the Elysran forces from the landing they had just made. However this proved difficult due to the Jomslandic swarm of drones and the technocratic barrage of missiles. In the end, the remaining Hydronian forces were forced to retreat back south. They made it look like they had retreated, but they actually waited 500km away for the arenetts to arrive, when they would relaunch their attack.

[b]Logistik und Nachschub[/b]

[b]-Refueling and Reload at Sea-[/b]

[i]At sea, the Kaiserliche Marines new transferrable reload at-sea method or SÜNAS allows the Reichswehrs fleets to reload their vertical launch missiles without stopping at a friendly port or base. Kaiserliche cargo ships, part of the merchant marine used for sealift and specialized for resupply come alongside the surface craft. Using the UNREP system various supplies are moved to the combatant ship including spare parts, ammunition, food, medical supplies, mail and others. Except this time missile canisters for the Donnerkeil cruise missiles are also used during UNREP to resupply the ship. Once aboard a set of rails direct the missile canister to its cell with the crew securing it. Through tensioned cables a constant supply of fuel is transferred from the cargo ship to the combatant to keep it running. The nuclear assets in the CSGs including submarines and the aircraft carriers dont need to refuel. Using this method the Kaiserliche Marine reloads its vertical missile systems once exhausted, allowing constant bombardment of Hydronia, and the Bobians. [/i]

[b]-Air and Sealift Into Nestorstaat- [/b]

[i]With Reichswehr control of the seas and airspace around the island, the Reichswehr would maintain a constant sealift and airlift to the island for a long-term engagement. Ammunition, blood, fuel, ordinance and others are brought to the island. A constant flurry of K-130 cargo aircraft would bring the most important supplies into the island while airlifting the most seriously wounded back to the mainland for immediate medical intervention. The merchant marine of the Kaiserliche Marine again plays a key role, maintaining a constant sealift of supplies into Nestorstaat. In addition, three more FAS-3 anti-air missile batteries would be brought to the island. Supplies having been built up since the first war would allow the Reichswehr to maintain a long term presence on the island even under THEP pressure.[/i] 

[b]-Nestorstaat Air Defenses-[/b]

[i]Since the conclusion of the first war the Reichswehr had worked to extend the air defenses that had protected the mainland to the island. What had ensued would create one of Erenes strongest air defenses, capable of countering combined THEP air power. Consisting of eight layers of missile defense the system would defend both the mainland and Nestorstaat. 

The outer layer is defended by the Speer-3 missile designed to intercept long-range hypersonic and ballistic missiles outside the atmosphere. Using vertical launchers the system tracks incoming missiles and launches the Speer-3 kinetic kill mechanisms. 

This is complemented by ship-launched SM-3 long-range midcourse interceptors. Using kinetic hit to kill capabilities their radars are complemented by infrared trackers giving them deadly accuracy. 

From the TKS Graf Bismarck and other guided missile cruisers comes the SM-6 missile designed to hit THEP aircraft out of the sky. This long-range missile is capable of hitting targets of up to 240 km. 

Then the Speer-A comes into play. While in the same family as the Speer-3 this missile is designed for within atmosphere interception. Using a proximity fuse it uses a warhead that explodes once the target comes close enough. A speed of mach 9 allows it to chase down the vast majority of enemy hypersonics. 

HITRAD batteries located on the island represent the fifth layer of ballistics defense. Once missiles reenter these kinetic kill vehicles knock them out of the sky. 

Then Steiner Schild comes into play allowing for medium range interception while Eiserner Schutz provides final short range defenses for strategic locations including major cities and bases. 

At targets such as runways C-RAMs also provide an extra layer of point defense with gatling guns and interceptor missiles combined. 
[/i]
